payload.claim: Revisit when any of the following happens. (1) Q3 FY2027 results, due 17 November 2026, land outside the $108.0bn +/-2% revenue guidance or the 74.0% gross margin guidance. (2) Q4 guidance confirms or refutes the reported 71-72% gross margin. (3) A permanent CEO is named, or the board investigation and FBI probe produce findings about the Megaspeed relationship; a finding that touches the accounts would escalate the integrity gate. (4) Receivables and free cash flow show whether Q2's weak cash conversion reverses or persists. (5) New disclosure on who stands behind the $105.0bn SB Energy residual-value guarantee, or any draw on it. (6) A statement of objections from the French Competition Authority, or a DOJ complaint over the Groq or Hugging Face deals. (7) The code-computed margin of safety turns materially positive across the measured discount rates once the newer quarters enter the annual figures.

prediction.reasoning: Consensus extrapolates +82.2%/yr for two years, but I expect growth in the year after FY2027 to fall below FY2026's 65.47% pace. The reasons are a far larger base after a near-doubling year, China excluded, 89.6% of revenue in one segment, five customers each holding 10-22% of receivables, receivables stretching from 45 to 60 days, a leadership vacuum, antitrust probes and possible margin slippage. The rate would still sit at or above the 34.9% the price requires, so this bets against consensus extrapolation, not against the price.
